text:
User asks: 根据ACMG规则评估 FGFR3;NM_000142.5:c.1075+95C>G 杂合变异致病性。

Assistant calls mcp__tooluniverse__find_tools and mcp__tooluniverse__execute_tool with GeneBe_classify_variant, SpliceAI_predict_splice, EnsemblVEP_annotate_hgvs, ClinVar_get_clinical_significance, and NCBIVariation_rsid_lookup. GeneBe reports Likely_pathogenic with criteria PS3, PM2, PP3_Moderate, PP5. SpliceAI reports DS_DG=0.97. ClinVar reports Pathogenic single submitter.

No PubMed, PMC, EuropePMC, or ToolUniverse literature search was run. No literature coverage audit was emitted.

FINAL ACMG CLASSIFICATION: Likely Pathogenic.
Applied evidence: PM2, PM4, PP3_Moderate, PP1_Moderate, PP4, PP5.
No acmg_assessment_bundle was emitted and no validator summary was run.
